runtimes.value: Official chatterbox-tts package on MPS (repo ships example_for_mac.py; multilingual v2 confirmed on an M5, needs PYTORCH_MPS_LOW_WATERMARK_RATIO to curb memory growth, issue #218 open); mlx-audio (MLX ports of Multilingual v2 and v3, mlx-community/chatterbox-fp16 and chatterbox-multilingual-v3). Not whisper.cpp, vLLM or Ollama
runtimes.source: https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox (README, example_for_mac.py, issues #218, #147); https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio (README model table)
runtimes.note: The official loader also reads a .pt (pickle) conditionals file; the mlx-audio ports are converted repos, not the ResembleAI files. Older open Mac issues (#147 'output channels > 65536 not supported on MPS', #85 torch.load on Mac) may be stale; not re-tested. Whether v3 runs on MPS with the official package is unverified.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of Ollama, QwenLM, resemble-ai/chatterbox and mlx-audio (now `Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio`). **Reddit could not be read.** Items from before 13.05.2026 that are not launch discussions are marked "older". Multilingual released in September 2025; window: since 13.05.2026. **Feedback thin; no FR/DE report.**
web.summary: Still used, judged more predictable than Qwen3-TTS by some; needs the MPS memory workaround on M5. Ships a `.pt` (pickle) file.
web.verdict: Still used; memory workaround needed on M5; no FR/DE report

comments.text: **M5 Mac**: memory grew to 28 GB for an 11 s line; `PYTORCH_MPS_LOW_WATERMARK_RATIO=0.3` brought it to 9.3 GB ([chatterbox#218, 31.10.2026](https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox/issues/218#issuecomment-6543892732)).
Reference in one language, text in another: accent carried over ([HF #55, 16.05.2026](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox/discussions/55)).
Artifacts at chunk joins in long texts ([HF #53, 27.08.2026](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox/discussions/53)).

Quality judged excellent on Mac and PC ([armcat, 21.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49392664)); still used as a specialty model ([itsdavesanders, 05.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50379352)).
